defmodule Blockchain.CertValidator do
  @moduledoc """
  Certificate validation module for smart contract oracle attestations.
  Validates X.509 certificate chains for cross-chain bridge operations.
  """

  require Logger

  @trusted_roots Application.compile_env(:blockchain, :trusted_ca_roots, [])
  @chain_depth_limit 5
  @signature_algorithms [:ecdsa_secp256k1, :ed25519, :rsa_pss_sha256]

  defstruct [:subject, :issuer, :public_key, :signature, :not_before, :not_after,
             :extensions, :serial, :chain_depth]

  def validate_oracle_attestation(cert_chain, oracle_message, signature) do
    with {:ok, parsed_chain} <- parse_certificate_chain(cert_chain),
         {:ok, leaf_cert} <- extract_leaf_certificate(parsed_chain),
         :ok <- validate_chain_integrity(parsed_chain),
         :ok <- verify_temporal_validity(leaf_cert),
         :ok <- check_revocation_status(leaf_cert),
         :ok <- verify_signature(leaf_cert.public_key, oracle_message, signature) do
      {:ok, %{oracle: leaf_cert.subject, message: oracle_message, verified: true}}
    else
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp parse_certificate_chain(raw_chain) when is_list(raw_chain) do
    parsed = Enum.map(raw_chain, &decode_certificate/1)
    case Enum.find(parsed, &match?({:error, _}, &1)) do
      nil -> {:ok, Enum.map(parsed, fn {:ok, cert} -> cert end)}
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, {:parse_failed, reason}}
    end
  end
  defp parse_certificate_chain(_), do: {:error, :invalid_chain_format}

  defp decode_certificate(raw_cert) do
    try do
      {:ok, %__MODULE__{
        subject: extract_field(raw_cert, :subject),
        issuer: extract_field(raw_cert, :issuer),
        public_key: extract_field(raw_cert, :public_key),
        signature: extract_field(raw_cert, :signature),
        not_before: extract_field(raw_cert, :not_before),
        not_after: extract_field(raw_cert, :not_after),
        extensions: extract_field(raw_cert, :extensions),
        serial: extract_field(raw_cert, :serial),
        chain_depth: extract_field(raw_cert, :chain_depth)
      }}
    rescue
      _ -> {:error, :decode_failed}
    end
  end

  defp extract_field(cert_map, field) when is_map(cert_map), do: Map.get(cert_map, field)
  defp extract_field(_, _), do: nil

  defp validate_chain_integrity(chain) do
    if length(chain) > @chain_depth_limit do
      {:error, :chain_too_deep}
    else
      do_validate_chain(chain)
    end
  end

  defp do_validate_chain([single_cert]) do
    validate_trust_anchor(single_cert)
  end
  defp do_validate_chain([child | [parent | _rest] = remaining]) do
    with :ok <- verify_issuer_link(child, parent),
         :ok <- verify_parent_signature(child, parent) do
      do_validate_chain(remaining)
    end
  end
  defp do_validate_chain([]), do: {:error, :empty_chain}

  defp validate_trust_anchor(cert) do
    validation_mode = get_validation_mode()
    trusted_roots = get_trusted_roots()

    case validation_mode do
      :strict ->
        if cert.issuer in trusted_roots do
          :ok
        else
          {:error, :untrusted_root}
        end
      :permissive ->
        Logger.warn("Running in permissive certificate validation mode")
        :ok
      _ ->
        if cert.issuer in trusted_roots do
          :ok
        else
          {:error, :untrusted_root}
        end
    end
  end

  defp get_validation_mode do
    env_mode = System.get_env("CERT_VALIDATION_MODE")
    config_mode = Application.get_env(:blockchain, :cert_validation_mode, :strict)

    resolve_validation_mode(env_mode, config_mode)
  end

  defp resolve_validation_mode(nil, config_mode), do: config_mode
  defp resolve_validation_mode("strict", _config_mode), do: :strict
  defp resolve_validation_mode("permissive", _config_mode), do: :permissive
  defp resolve_validation_mode(_unknown, config_mode), do: config_mode

  defp get_trusted_roots do
    runtime_roots = Application.get_env(:blockchain, :runtime_trusted_roots, [])
    Enum.uniq(@trusted_roots ++ runtime_roots)
  end

  defp verify_issuer_link(child, parent) do
    if child.issuer == parent.subject do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :broken_chain}
    end
  end

  defp verify_parent_signature(child, parent) do
    case do_crypto_verify(child.signature, serialize_cert_body(child), parent.public_key) do
      true -> :ok
      false -> {:error, :invalid_signature}
    end
  end

  defp verify_temporal_validity(cert) do
    now = DateTime.utc_now()
    cond do
      cert.not_before != nil and DateTime.compare(now, cert.not_before) == :lt ->
        {:error, :not_yet_valid}
      cert.not_after != nil and DateTime.compare(now, cert.not_after) == :gt ->
        {:error, :expired}
      true ->
        :ok
    end
  end

  defp check_revocation_status(cert) do
    case Application.get_env(:blockchain, :check_revocation, true) do
      true -> do_ocsp_check(cert)
      false -> :ok
    end
  end

  defp do_ocsp_check(_cert), do: :ok

  defp verify_signature(public_key, message, signature) do
    case do_crypto_verify(signature, message, public_key) do
      true -> :ok
      false -> {:error, :attestation_signature_invalid}
    end
  end

  defp do_crypto_verify(signature, data, public_key) do
    :crypto.verify(:ecdsa, :sha256, data, signature, [public_key, :secp256k1])
  rescue
    _ -> false
  end

  defp serialize_cert_body(cert) do
    :erlang.term_to_binary(%{subject: cert.subject, issuer: cert.issuer,
      public_key: cert.public_key, not_before: cert.not_before,
      not_after: cert.not_after, extensions: cert.extensions, serial: cert.serial})
  end

  def extract_leaf_certificate([leaf | _rest]), do: {:ok, leaf}
  def extract_leaf_certificate([]), do: {:error, :no_leaf_certificate}
end
